From the karahi & the grill

Signature Dishes

The dishes that built the name — karahi cooked to order, BBQ straight off the coals, and slow, honest rosh. Call ahead to place your order.

Mutton / Chicken Karahi

The house signature — meat wok-tossed in tomato, green chilli, ginger and black pepper, served bubbling in the karahi it was cooked in.

House Signature

BBQ Tikka

Marinated chicken tikka grilled over open charcoal — smoky edges, juicy centre, and that unmistakable BBQ char.

Charcoal BBQ

Malai Boti

Soft, creamy-marinated chicken boti, grilled until lightly charred. Mild, rich and melt-in-the-mouth — a family favourite.

Creamy & Mild

Kabli Pulao

The Afghan classic: fragrant rice with tender meat, sweet carrot, raisins and almonds. Gentle, aromatic and deeply satisfying.

Afghan Classic

Quetta Rosh

Namkeen rosh in the Quetta style — meat cooked simply with salt and its own juices, so the true flavour of the mutton leads.

Namkeen Style

White Rosh

A lighter rosh, kept pale and clean-tasting — tender meat in a mild, white preparation for those who like it simple and pure.

Light & Mild
Our story

Serving Johar Town since 2001

Shaheen Shinwari Restaurant and B.B.Q has been part of Johar Town's food scene since 2001 — more than two decades of Afghan and Pakistani cooking on Khayaban-e-Firdousi Road.

The Shinwari way is simple: good meat, minimal fuss, and fire. Karahis are cooked fresh, BBQ comes straight off the coals, and rosh is kept honest — the way it has been made for generations.

  • Cuisine: Afghan + Pakistani — karahi, BBQ, pulao & rosh
  • Established: 2001
  • Find us: Block R1 Phase 2, Johar Town, Lahore
